note_evidence: The track delivers a massive, distorted 808 bass with prominent pitch slides and a classic tamborzao rhythm starting right at 00:02.
beat_evidence: A strong, unmistakable funk carioca beat establishes a clear pulse from the very first second and maintains it perfectly.
loop_evidence: The track starts at full energy with no dead intro and cuts off abruptly at 00:40 while still at peak intensity, ideal for a seamless loop.
